name: 11L LeakyReLU² + Partial RoPE + Int6 + EMA
blurb: LeakyReLU(0.5)² activation applied to the PR #414 base (11L, 512d, 8H/4KV, 3x MLP). Key techniques: partial RoPE (16/64 dims), LN scale 1/sqrt(layer+1), BigramHash(2048), Value Embedding on layers 9-10, XSA on last 4 layers, EMA averaging (decay=0.997), late QAT at scale<0.15, int6 GPTQ-lite quantization + zstd compression, sliding window eval (stride=64), warmdown 3500 steps. LeakyReLU provides -0.003 BPB over relu² by preserving negative gradient flow.
author: vibhu1510
